verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's built-in RAG pulls information from the user's local and remote documents into AI chat responses, and in-product Python execution can analyze data, so users get AI-generated insights from their data on request. There is no evidence of proactive insight or suggestion features, and community users report that RAG failed for them without a GPU or when using only external APIs, which weakens confidence without contradicting the documented capability. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic insight/suggestion surfacing, documentation of data-analysis workflows, and independent confirmation that RAG works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: RAG can retrieve and incorporate the relevant information from that source into the chat response.
retrieving relevant information from a wide range of sources such as local and remote documents, web content, and even multimedia sources like YouTube videos.
Run Python directly in the browser or via Open Terminal
